result.summary: No critical visual breakage detected. The layout, navigation, and sections render correctly. Found 2 minor inconsistencies: uneven thumbnail fill in the fastest-near-you carousel and a questionable -100% promo badge.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail in 'Fastest near you' shows a small centered illustration with large empty beige space, while neighboring cards are filled edge-to-edge, creating inconsistent visual weight.
issues.suggestion: Ensure all restaurant thumbnails use the same aspect ratio, scaling and cropping so images fill the card consistently.

issues.description: The second card under 'Popular right now' shows a '-100%' badge which looks like an erroneous or placeholder promotion value.
issues.suggestion: Verify promotion data and display intended discount format, e.g. percentage off an item vs free delivery, to avoid confusing '-100%' labeling.
